description: Models for the dog_capture v1 engine. Files live in models/pretrained/dog_capture_v1/ (override with DOG_CAPTURE_MODELS). Lower priority number = preferred by detector.kind=auto.

models.name: dog_face_pose
models.obtain: tools/train_dog_face_pose.py prepare -> pseudolabel (teacher eyes) -> train -> export; see docs/DOG_CAPTURE_ENGINE_CN.md section 6
models.license: Ultralytics AGPL-3.0 unless you hold an Enterprise licence; StanfordExtra/Stanford Dogs are research data; a DogFLW teacher adds its CC BY-NC 4.0 terms
models.edge: ~3 M parameters at 640 or 480 input; exports to ONNX, TFLite, CoreML, NCNN, RKNN, TensorRT via Ultralytics

models.name: anyface_yolov5l6
models.obtain: python src/Pet-ReID-IMAG/tools/export_anyface_onnx.py --weights models/pretrained/anyface/yolov5l6_best.pt --size 640 (the .pt is already in the local workspace, SHA-256 b78a85f5...)
models.license: AnyFace code MIT, YOLOv5-face code GPL-3.0; weights trained on WIDER FACE / AnimalWeb (research datasets). Check before commercial use.
models.edge: YOLOv5l6, ~76 M parameters: desktop GPU class, not phone class

models.name: scrfd_dog
models.obtain: Train InsightFace SCRFD (MIT) on dog faces with 5 points (e.g. AnyFace-format labels) and export with its scrfd2onnx tool.
